name: Being Like The World
overview: Scripture teaches that believers must choose to serve God rather than the world, as serving two masters is impossible (Matthew 6:24). While God loved the world enough to send His Son for salvation (John 3:16), followers of Christ are called to reject conformity to worldly patterns and instead be transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Jesus warned that the world will oppose His followers as it opposed Him (John 15:18), and believers are instructed to avoid fellowship with darkness and to expose its fruitless deeds (Ephesians 5:11), living as light in a dark world (John 12:46).
